# OPSQAI

> OPSQAI builds your workspace around your problems. You tell us the problem; we analyze the root cause, design the solution and build it into your OPSQAI Workspace — a Windows Self-Hosted product your employees actually use. OPSQAI Cloud (Management Center and Customer Portal) exists only for licensing, releases, installer distribution and customer support. Customers own their data, documents, embeddings and AI provider.

## The model

- OPSQAI Discovery: Problem → Diagnosis → Solution design → Workspace. Every engagement starts with the customer's problem, not a product catalogue. Discovery delivers a written diagnosis report, a proposed workspace configuration, a value estimate and a direct path into a 30-day pilot.
- We do not compete on feature lists. If a module does not solve your problem, it is not in your workspace.

## Product architecture

- Management Center (cloud, OPSQAI staff only): companies, installations, licenses, releases, signing keys, activation bundles, ownership, support, audit.
- Customer Portal (cloud, customer contacts): installer downloads, updates, activation bundles, documentation, release notes, subscription and support.
- Self-Hosted (Windows, the actual product): AI Chat, Knowledge Base, FAQ, Academy, AI Audit, Users, Organization, Subscription, Updates, Modules.
